summary: Blaze Type's microsite for Area, an 88-style variable neo-grotesque (wght, wdth, slnt and a custom INKT inktrap axis): a brutalist-architecture video hero with an animated stack of 'AREA', a drop-cap intro and facts table, then numbered chapters on the variable system, pairing with Blaze display faces, Futura-inspired alternates, inktraps and interface use, broken up by textured photo panels with Normal/Extended switches. Fixed green 'Buy Area' and black 'Download Trial' pills float at the top throughout.

instances.look: A rounded full-width video of a misty concrete building (camera gliding past balconies), with a centred white stack: five small 'AREA' lines growing heavier and wider, 'B L A Z E  T Y P E' letter-spaced, then five more 'AREA' lines growing to ~70px
instances.ux: The stack's lines interpolate wght, wdth and INKT in a staggered loop over the drifting video; fixed Buy/Trial pills at the top
instances.learn: Stack the name ten times and give each line a slightly different point on all axes, then animate them: the whole design space reads as one moving column

reconstruction.layout: Video panel 1440×~870px with ~16px rounded corners and ~0 margin; stack centred at x=720 from y≈130 to y≈730; line heights growing from ~24px to ~80px
reconstruction.typography: Area uppercase, white, wide tracking; variation per line from wght 100/wdth 100/INKT 0 up to wght ~897/wdth ~199/INKT ~99; 'BLAZE TYPE' ~28px with ~0.6em tracking
reconstruction.behaviour: Looping JS/CSS interpolation of font-variation-settings ('INKT', 'wdth', 'wght') per line with a phase offset; background autoplaying muted video; intro shows only the pills on white for ~2s while the video loads
reconstruction.content: Family name and foundry name only
reconstruction.assets: Architectural video loop (3D render or film of brutalist concrete)
reconstruction.html: spans with inline font-variation-settings: "INKT" n, "slnt" 0, "wdth" n, "wght" n
